test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the legislation that does NOT deal with the protection of environment.
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Port Laws Amendment Act,1997.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Port Laws Amendment Act,1997**

 
 
• **​**The Major Ports Trust Act, 1963, was amended by** the Port Laws (Amendment) Act, 1997.**
 
• It was to constitute the TAMP.
 
• Minor ports are outside the ambit of TAMP.
 
• Once the major ports are converted from trusts into corporate entities, they go out of the ambit of the Major Port Trusts Act, 1963.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Forest (Conservation) Act,1980**

 
 
• The Forest (Conservation) Act of 1980 is an act by the Parliament of India.
 
• It ensures the conservation of forests and its resources.
 
• It came into force on **October 25, 1980.**
 
 
 
• **The Water (Cess) Act,1977**
 
 
• **​**The Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Cess Act was enacted in **1977**.
 
• It was to provide for the levy and collection of a cess on water consumed by persons.
 
 
 
• **The Public Liability Insurance Act,1991**
 
 
• **​**The Public Liability Insurance Act, 1991, was enacted after the Bhopal gas tragedy.
 
• It says that the owner of a company compensates victims of accidents, irrespective of neglect. 
 
 

5e:T
